description: This file defines Flask API routes and schemas for managing test cases, including CRUD operations, using Flask-Smorest and Marshmallow schemas.

classes.name: TestCaseMetadataSchema
classes.description: Schema for arbitrary test case metadata, allowing any key-value pairs.

classes.name: TestCaseBaseSchema
classes.description: Base schema for test case data, including title, description, steps, tags, and metadata.

classes.name: TestCaseCreateSchema
classes.description: Schema for creating a new test case, inherits from TestCaseBaseSchema.

classes.name: TestCaseUpdateSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing test case with optional fields.

classes.name: TestCaseSchema
classes.description: Schema representing a complete test case with ID and timestamps.

classes.name: TestCaseListResource
classes.description: API resource class for listing and creating test cases.

classes.name: TestCaseResource
classes.description: API resource class for retrieving, updating, and deleting a specific test case.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all test cases or retrieve a specific test case by ID.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new test case.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing test case by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a test case by ID.
